Proposition
[Derivative of the extension] 1. 11.1.2\group derivatives Source: thurston:page-0307

The extension is natural under hyperbolic isometries: $\operatorname {ex}(T_*X)=T_*\operatorname {ex}(X)$. If $Y$ is an infinitesimal translation whose axis passes through $x$, then \[ abla _{Y_x}\operatorname {ex}X=\operatorname {ex}[Y,X]. \]
Proof

\sketch Differentiate naturality at the identity to obtain $\operatorname {ex}[Y,X]=[Y,\operatorname {ex}X]$. Along the axis, $ abla _XY=0$, and the identity $[Y,X]= abla _YX- abla _XY$ yields the formula.
